column3: “It was devastated … destroyed” is rendered in the present, “is devastated and ruined.”
“The house” is rendered “the temple,” and “diminished” as “cut off.”
“Going down in weeping” is rendered “dissolved in tears.”
NASB adds “over their ruin” to “a cry of shattering.”
“The wadi of the poplars” is rendered as a name, “the brook of Arabim.”
